ValidationRule.description: Prevents the user from funding a record if the Actuals Audit Complete is not checked.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( RecordType.Name = 'Working Capital Oppty', RecordType.Name = 'FRPSA', RecordType.Name = 'Broker WC Oppty', RecordType.Name = 'Broker FRPSA', RecordType.Name = 'MLP' ), CONTAINS(Lender_Account__r.Name, 'National Funding'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Funded'), ISCHANGED(StageName), Actuals_Audit_Complete__c = FALSE )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Actuals Audit Complete must be checked prior to Funding.
